findings.title: Client response validation rejects before transient capture

sourceEvidence.captureBehavior: Only a fulfilled client return is serialized; rejected method bodies are unavailable to catch recovery.

findings.failureCase: 2xx response has malformed tuple or id and contains planted canary; validation throws inside client before wrapper captures it.
findings.requiredChange: Capture complete successful GET/PUT response transiently before rejecting its tuple; enforce matching id and safe positive numeric revisions before PUT/suffix respectively.
requiredFocusedRegressions: Malformed GET tuple plus canary: detected by catch scan, no PUT or suffix, no raw canary record
Malformed PUT response plus canary: detected by catch scan, one attempted PUT/no retry, no suffix, no raw canary record
Both retain one known base charge, no extra model/session charge, and incomplete observation

accepted: Positive safe integer numeric tuple and identity validation without coercion/default/increments
Tuple serialized after untrusted authoring.request spread
One GET/PUT with server optimistic CAS and no409 retry/rebase
Original base frozen tuple and publication identity retained; suffix uses updated tuple
Focused changed-behavior verification plus existing group5/type-check/changed-file lint only
